# Ashcombe community minibus: the Thursday run

Last year the Thursday minibus to the market town made 46 trips and carried 4 passengers on average. It needs 9 a trip to cover its fuel.

Already proposed (parish council minutes, May):

- Saturday run to the swimming pool and the weekend market: a second weekly route on a day when more people are free. Not started: the parish has one driver with the licence for the bus, and Thursday already uses them.
- Door-to-door pickups by booking: riders ring a number the day before and the bus collects them from their own gate. Dropped: too much to set up, since someone has to take the calls and plan a new route each week.

Limits: no money beyond the current fuel budget, and the bus seats 12 and is the parish's only vehicle.
